summary.en: Organise named types into packages and understand imports, folders and classpath roots.
summary.bn: প্যাকেজে টাইপ সাজিয়ে import, ফোল্ডার আর classpath-এর সম্পর্ক বুঝুন।

notes: Named packages, imports and selected static imports are supported by Java 17; modules are a separate later subject.

sections.title: Give types an address in a larger project
Map a qualified name below a root folder
Name library types and selected members
Imports resolve names rather than move code
Packages are boundaries with practical consequences
Use the right name at each stage
Packages and modules are different layers
Keep namespace, path and launch root aligned

examples.title: Import a library type
examples.explanationHtml: The import makes Arrays a short name for java.util.Arrays. It does not copy library code into the source.

examples.title: Use a fully qualified name
examples.explanationHtml: The full package name avoids an import. The fixed date prints 2026-11-19, independent of the current clock.

examples.title: Import selected static operations
examples.explanationHtml: Static imports make max and abs available without writing Math before each call.

examples.title: Two ways to name one type
examples.explanationHtml: StringBuilder belongs to java.lang. Its short name and fully qualified name identify the same library type.

practice.title: Import Arrays for a display
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 10 and n integer values. Import java.util.Arrays explicitly and print the array with Arrays.toString.
hints: An import declaration follows any package declaration.

practice.title: Name Math fully
practice.statementHtml: Input: an integer from -100 to 100. Print its absolute value using java.lang.Math.abs with the full type name.
hints: No explicit Math import is needed.

practice.title: Static import maximum
practice.statementHtml: Input: two integers from -100 to 100. Use a selected static import of Math.max to print the greater.
hints: Import a static member rather than an instance method.

practice.title: Plan a named package
practice.statementHtml: A public Student type belongs to campus.model and a public App entry point belongs to campus.app. Show source layout, compilation command and launch name.
hints: Read the fully qualified name as package plus class.
practice.answerHtml:
src/campus/model/Student.java
src/campus/app/App.java
classes/campus/model/Student.class
classes/campus/app/App.class

Student.java begins with package campus.model; and App.java with package campus.app;. App imports campus.model.Student. From the project root, use javac --release 17 -d classes src/campus/model/Student.java src/campus/app/App.java, then java -cp classes campus.app.App. The classpath root is classes, not classes/campus/app.

practice.title: Resolve an import conflict
practice.statementHtml: Two libraries define a Date type. Explain why importing both with the same simple name is a problem and give a repair.
hints: An import is a name shortcut, not a new type.
practice.answerHtml: A simple Date name would be ambiguous, and two single-type imports with that name conflict. Import the commonly used type and name the other with its fully qualified package name, or fully qualify both. Java has no import alias syntax.

quiz.prompt: Does an explicit Arrays import change the values being displayed?
quiz.explanation: Arrays.toString formats the existing order. Importing a type does not sort the array.

quiz.prompt: Which operation is called after a selected static import of max?
quiz.explanation: The imported Math.max returns the greater operand, 5.

quiz.prompt: Which length does a fully qualified StringBuilder type report?
quiz.explanation: The fully qualified name identifies the normal StringBuilder class; CSE has length 3.

quiz.prompt: Where does package campus.model; appear in an ordinary source file?
quiz.explanation: A package declaration describes the compilation unit, not a method or object.

quiz.prompt: What is the fully qualified name of Student in campus.model?
quiz.explanation: Qualified Java names use dots. Filesystem paths and class names are related but distinct.

quiz.prompt: Which folder should be the classpath root for classes/campus/model/Student.class?
quiz.explanation: The runtime maps the qualified name to package folders below the root.

quiz.prompt: Does import campus.model.Student load that class immediately?
options: Yes; every import runs a constructor
No; it resolves a source-level name
quiz.explanation: Imports help compilation. Runtime loading and initialization follow separate rules.

quiz.prompt: Does import java.util.* include java.util.concurrent types?
options: Yes; all nested package names are included
quiz.explanation: A wildcard type import covers one package, not its subpackages.

quiz.prompt: What can a static import import?
options: Private instance fields from any class
quiz.explanation: Static import shortens access to eligible static members while preserving visibility checks.

quiz.prompt: Can a named package import a class from the unnamed package?
options: No; use named packages for reusable types
quiz.explanation: Unnamed-package classes are unsuitable for use from named packages.

options: The root under which compiled package folders are written
quiz.explanation: The -d option selects the output root; package names determine the folders below it.

keyPoints.en: A package gives a type a namespace.
keyPoints.bn: প্যাকেজ টাইপকে আলাদা নামের জায়গা দেয়।

keyPoints.en: The package declaration precedes import declarations.
keyPoints.bn: package ঘোষণার পরে import ঘোষণা লেখা হয়।

keyPoints.en: An import shortens a type name without changing access rights.
keyPoints.bn: import টাইপের নাম ছোট করে লেখায় সাহায্য করে, অ্যাক্সেস বাড়ায় না।

keyPoints.en: Static import makes selected static members available by short name.
keyPoints.bn: static import দিয়ে নির্দিষ্ট static মেম্বার ছোট নামে লেখা যায়।

keyPoints.en: The classpath root sits above the package folders.
keyPoints.bn: classpath-এর শুরু প্যাকেজের ফোল্ডারগুলোর উপরে থাকে।

keyPoints.en: java.lang types are available without explicit imports.
keyPoints.bn: java.lang-এর টাইপ আলাদা import না করেও ব্যবহার করা যায়।

examQuestions.question: Give compilation and launch commands for campus.app.App under src with output in classes.
examQuestions.answerHtml: From the project root use javac --release 17 -d classes src/campus/app/App.java, including dependency source paths as needed. Launch with java -cp classes campus.app.App. App must declare package campus.app and expose the usual main method.

examQuestions.question: Distinguish a type import from a static import.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A type import makes a type name available without its package prefix. A static import makes selected accessible static member names available without a type prefix.

examQuestions.question: Explain why changing a package declaration without adjusting build layout can break launching.
examQuestions.answerHtml: The binary name includes the package. javac -d writes matching package folders. The launcher must receive the qualified class name and a classpath root above those folders. Searching from the package folder itself starts too low.
